semantic_contract: allocate the ztp device with devm_kmalloc and return -ENOMEM on failure
store the pdev back-reference at cdev + 0xdc8, publish tpd_cdev and pdev + 0xa8, then register the platform device
parse the tp_algo, long-press, ghost-check, jitter, edge-suppression and ufp Device Tree properties with stock defaults
initialize the three probe-local mutexes with distinct lockdep keys and create the proc/sysfs interface paths
run event cleanup, ghost reset, ufp initialization and workqueue initialization; return -ENOMEM when workqueue setup fails
on success initialize delayed work, zlog/timestamp fields, waitqueue state and return zero
follow_up_required: Review the three Joern high-severity findings before any hardware promotion: one allocation-lifetime finding and two synchronization findings.
Keep the nine-instruction default ghost-config register/order difference separate from semantic parity and recheck if byte-level parity becomes a requirement.
Run controlled platform-bus, procfs/sysfs and NX809J runtime validation only after the offline driver set is complete.
unverified: actual devm allocator, platform bus and procfs/sysfs behavior in the target kernel
mutex lockdep class behavior under concurrent access
complete module integration and boot behavior
decision_basis: Ghidra pseudocode/P-Code, normalized AArch64 dataflow, matching instruction count/size/section/KCFI, Joern strict graph gate with explicit findings, reproducible Docker build and four-case two-cycle ASan/UBSan host contract. No smartphone test was performed.
